problem_statement: A UDP socket that has been shut down for reading (shutdown with the read half closed) must no longer receive data. After such a shutdown, incoming datagrams destined for that socket should be discarded, and a non-blocking receive on it should return an error rather than delivering data that arrives from a peer. Currently the socket keeps a receive path active: a send or connect on the same socket re-arms its receive handling, and incoming packets are still queued, so data arrives even though the read side was explicitly closed.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/socket/udp -s tests/net/socket/udp/net.socket.udp -s net.socket.udp -O twister-out --no-clean -W
